[[Adhitok]] is an apothecary who is searching the [[Plains of Jarin]] for a cure for the magical plague that has struck his home village.

==Locations==
* [[Istan]]
** {{NPC location|Plains of Jarin}} (Just outside [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]])

==Dialogue==
:''"I came here to investigate rumors that these plants can cure any illness; even magical ones. We have many sick people in my home village.
